Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. 

We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. 

We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. 
That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT. 

Internship description: 

We're looking for a proactive and ambitious student to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. You'll be part of the Sales Intelligence team, we're at the core of data-driven success in the On-Trade Channel Belgium (Horeca). Our goal is to leverage data to improve the efficiency of our sales teams, drive business decisions & Strategy by delivering the right insights to leadership and making our business more fact-based & data driven. By becoming part of this wonderful team, you will be given responsibility over several key projects. You will report to the Sales Intelligence Analysts On Trade BE. 

What will you do during the internship? 

• Improvement of sales intelligence related processes.   
• Participate in strategic discussions with sales managers   
• Collaborate with other departments (TM, Finance, RM, etc.) on diverse projects.   
• Data Governance: data quality, master data and data enrichment  
• Improve business reporting 
Internship duration: 

Minimum 3 months, starting in October 

Compensation:     

Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 

Learning opportunities:  

70% of your learning will come from on-the-job learning. As an intern, you'll get the chance to experience the real-life business whilst developing your skills - learning through experiencing different areas and building your own reputation.  

20% of your learning will come from mentorship programs, coaching, collaboration with key stakeholders & plenty of opportunities for feedback.  

10% of your learning will come from formal training, including workshops & online training courses. We will provide you with continuous opportunities to elevate your skills with access to free training sessions facilitated by AB InBev and LinkedIn Learning. 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Final years of relevant bachelor's or master's degree program (business, finance or engineering)   
• Result driven, solution oriented and can-do spirit  
• Passionate about turning data into insights and opportunities  
• Continuous drive for improvements  
• Advanced user of Microsoft Excel is an asset  
• Fluent in English. French or Dutch is a plus   
Why build your career with us: 

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.   

UNIQUE CULTURE 

We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.     

BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES 

We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.     

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES 

Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth.   

If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.

For a key Belgian player in the energy transition, JOBS IN MIND is looking for a Site Engineer to join a major offshore high-voltage infrastructure project. You will contribute to the development of new energy infrastructure connecting Belgian offshore wind power to the electricity grid.
 

Your role
 

As Site Engineer, you will be part of the construction team and work across the sites in Vlissingen and Schiedam, combined with the office in Brussels. You report to the Construction Lead and act as a key link between engineering, construction, quality and the EPC contractor.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring safety and quality on site 

• Providing technical follow-up, mainly for electromechanical works 

• Acting as the main contact for technical questions from the engineering team 

• Supporting the Construction Manager and site team 

• Taking technical ownership of issues arising during outfitting and escalating major issues when required 

• Coordinating and participating in site inspections 

• Following up on quality issues and non-conformities 

• Reviewing technical documentation submitted by the contractor 

• Coordinating suppliers and external parties on site 

• Managing and structuring incoming inspection reports 

• Preparing weekly and monthly reports 

• Supporting technical analyses and improvement initiatives  

You will work in a multidisciplinary team with inspectors, outfitting engineers, design engineers, construction managers and other project specialists.
 

The project
 

The project involves the development of a new offshore energy hub to connect Belgian offshore wind farms to the electricity grid. The infrastructure includes:
 
 

• An artificial energy island with offshore transmission infrastructure 

• AC substations at 66 kV and 220 kV 

• 6 export cable systems of approximately 50 km each  

Construction of the substations is currently ongoing in Vlissingen and Schiedam. Outfitting activities are starting in summer 2026, making this a key position for the next phase of the project.

Profile:
 
 

• Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering 

• Offshore experience is a strong plus 

• Experience with topside outfitting is a plus 

• Experience across multiple technical disciplines is an advantage 

• Experience with QA/QC on a construction site is a plus 

• VCA VOL / SCC Supervisor certificate 

• Strong MS Office skills and good technical reporting abilities 

• Knowledge of Aconex is a plus 

• Strong safety and quality mindset 

• Structured and team-oriented way of working 

• Strong communication skills 

• Quick learner 

• Own standard PPE is required 

• Languages: Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.  

Practical information
 
 

• Employment: Full-time, 5 days per week / 8 hours per day 

• Locations: Vlissingen, Schiedam and Brussels 

• Preferred: Based in Belgium or the Netherlands  

For non-EU candidates, a valid work permit and residence permit allowing employment in Belgium are required.
 

Why this project?
 

This is an opportunity to join a technically challenging offshore energy project directly contributing to the energy transition. You will work with international engineering and construction teams and gain valuable experience within a high-impact infrastructure project.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

mozzeno is a 100% Belgian digital lender that has established itself as a key player in the credit market.
 

Every day, we help individuals and businesses finance their projects through a simple, fast and fully digital process. Our strength? A unique blend of technology and human support, allowing us to deliver an efficient and personalised service.

In parallel, we give investors the opportunity to actively support the real economy in Belgium by financing the loans granted by mozzeno.
 

Based in 
Louvain-la-Neuve and currently experiencing strong growth, mozzeno is looking for an 
AI Automation Engineer to design, orchestrate and AI-augment our business processes.
 

Job content
 

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes — increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:
 
 

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell — scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation. 

• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify — our AI workflow platform — to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes. 

• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems — understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other. 

• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work. 

• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
 

• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience. 

• You are 
proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work — comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code. 

• You have a genuine interest in 
AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with 
Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as 
prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process. 

• You are comfortable 
integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end. 

• You are at ease in a 
cloud environment (Google, AWS). 

• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them. 

• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts. 

• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 

• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation. 

• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset

YOUR PROFILE
 

Distrilog is always looking for motivated employees who want to be part of our growing family.
 

Do you have an interest or experience in the logistics sector? Are you not afraid to work in a cool or cold environment? Are you looking for a job in the evening shift in Londerzeel? Then read on, apply, and make sure you're in the driver's seat of your dream job in no time!
 

YOUR TASKS
 

 
• As a versatile warehouse worker at Distrilog, you will have a wide range of responsibilities, including:
 
• unloading, checking, and sorting goods;
 
• processing orders using a handheld scanner;
 
• transporting goods using an electric or manual pallet truck;
 
• bringing prepared orders to the correct loading dock.
 
• In addition, you have an eye for cleanliness, and keeping the warehouse tidy is also part of your duties. 

 
 

PROFILE
 

 
• You have at least 2 consecutive years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment and a stable professional track record.
 
• Your colleagues and supervisor can rely on you.
 
• You work accurately, ensuring customers always receive the correct order.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.
 
• Commuting daily to Londerzeel with your own transport is no problem for you.
 
• You are punctual, motivated, and a hard worker.
 
• You work from 13:14 to 21:30.
 
• You are willing to work in a refrigerated environment (2°C).
 
• You are willing to work on Saturdays.

jobs.occupation: Network & Security Architect / Lead Engineer (freelance) M/W/X
jobs.description:
As a Network & Security Architect / Lead Engineer, you will join the Network & Security Team and play a key role in the design, evolution and implementation of the network and security landscape within a complex enterprise environment.

The assignment combines approximately 50% architecture and design with 50% hands-on engineering and troubleshooting.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Defining and developing Network & Security architectures, including HLD and LLD
• Establishing technical roadmaps and standards
• Leading and supporting datacenter projects and migrations
• Translating business and technical requirements into scalable solutions
• Reviewing implementations and ensuring technical quality
• Contributing directly to operational support and complex L3 troubleshooting
• Supporting critical incidents and problem analysis
• Coaching and guiding engineers within the team
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
This role requires a senior professional who can combine architectural thinking, technical leadership and hands-on expertise in a complex Network & Security environment.
 
We are looking for a Senior Network & Security professional, typically with 8+ years of experience, combining proven architecture and design expertise with a strong hands-on engineering background.

You have practical experience in complex enterprise and datacenter environments and are comfortable acting both as a technical architect and as a senior engineer involved in implementation and L3 troubleshooting.
Required expertise
• Strong experience in Network & Security architecture and design
• Practical Cisco ACI experience - mandatory
• Cisco Nexus
• Palo Alto NGFW and Prisma
• Firewalling, VPN, segmentation and Zero Trust
• VMware NSX
• Load balancing
• High-availability and mission-critical environments
• Multi-vendor enterprise environments
• Experience with complex migration and transformation projects
• Cisco certification (CCNP or higher) or equivalent expertise through experience
Experience with network automation, CI/CD and/or scripting is considered an advantage. PCNSE and/or Cisco ACI certifications are strong assets.

You combine an architectural mindset with a hands-on approach, have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and stakeholders. You are comfortable coaching engineers, sharing knowledge and acting as a technical reference within the team.

Fluent Dutch and English are required.
 Job Benefits
• Long-term assignment: 12 months+, renewable
• Hybrid working: approximately 4 days remote and 1 day per week onsite in Brussels
• Full-time assignment
• Work within a complex, enterprise-scale public-sector environment
• Combination of architecture/design and hands-on engineering
• Exposure to business-critical Network & Security infrastructure
• Opportunity to act as a technical reference and coach within the team
• Freelance / Time & Material contract

jobs.description:
As an ICT Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of strategic IT projects, with a strong focus on datacenter and infrastructure projects.

You will manage the planning, execution and follow-up of projects throughout their lifecycle and act as the main point of contact for project teams, management and external partners.

Your responsibilities include:

• Leading complex IT projects involving datacenter infrastructure, workplace environments, networks and system migrations.
• Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Program Manager or Service Manager.
• Coordinating the installation and equipment of physical datacenter environments.
• Managing network and system implementations, application migrations and handover to operational teams.
• Organising project meetings and facilitating alignment between all stakeholders.
• Leading and motivating project team members, with attention to team dynamics and coaching.
• Ensuring clear and effective communication throughout the project. 
We are looking for a Medior/Senior ICT Project Manager with solid experience in IT infrastructure projects within large and complex environments.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, with experience in infrastructure project management.
• Master's degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent through professional experience.
• Strong knowledge of both Waterfall and Agile project methodologies.
• Broad IT infrastructure experience, including datacenter migrations, workplace/endpoint management, virtualisation, network and system management.
• Demonstrated experience with physical datacenter installations, network and system implementations, application migrations, infrastructure roll-outs and handover to operational teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Professional knowledge of Dutch, French and English.
• Willingness to travel to client locations throughout Belgium. 
• Long-term assignment with the possibility of renewal.
• Full-time assignment of approximately 220 working days.
• Home Office is included in the working arrangement.
• Client assignments across Belgium, with location depending on the consultant's place of residence.
• Opportunity to work on complex and strategic IT infrastructure projects, including datacenter, network, system, workplace and migration projects.

An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. The role focuses on operational cybersecurity activities, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response support, security assessments, and continuous improvement of security controls.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

Practical information

 
• Location: Seraing (Liège), Belgium
 
• Contract type: open to freelance consultant or permanent employee, depending on profile
 
• Start date: as soon as possible
 
• Remote work: hybrid model with 2 days per week remote and 3 days on site
 
• Travel: no travel required
 
• Reporting line: Cybersec Operations Manager
 
• Working language: French for day-to-day team interactions, with professional English required for documentation, tools, and international stakeholders
 
• Team context: the IT Security team is being structured and scaled, in a build environment rather than a steady-state operation

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:

 
• Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
 
• Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
 
• Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
 
• Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
 
• Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:

 
• Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
 
• Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
 
• Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
 
• Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
 
• Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:

 
• Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
 
• Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
 
• Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
 
• Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:

 
• Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
 
• Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
 
• Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
 
• Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
 
• Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:

 
• Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
 
• Contribute to...
...

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role

• Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management

• Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

 

Technical knowledge:

• Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles

• Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity

For our client, an international company who produces frozen potato products, we are looking for production operators in 2 shifts.

What does your job responsibility involve?

 
• 
You will be responsible for setting up and starting up the machine

 
• 
You are responsible for converting and operating the production lines

 
• 
You ensure that the packaging lines work optimally and make adjustments where necessary

 
• 
You solve minor malfunctions or provide correct information to technical colleagues

 
• 
You carry out the necessary checks

 
• 
You have an eye for quality while performing your job

 
• 
You have a strong interest in technology

 
• 
You have technical insight and are quality-conscious

 
• 
You can work independently but can also cooperate with colleagues

 
• 
You may be interested in mastering other tasks and responsibilities

 
• 
You preferably have an A2 education in a technical field or have a strong affinity for technology

 
• 
You have a strong knowledge of English,French of Nederlands

 
• 
You are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.
